## Round g1r1 (2026-11-23)
- Workload: q16 only (count DISTINCT ps_suppkey GROUP BY p_brand,p_type,p_size; partsupp JOIN part, NOT IN supplier MARK join). Baseline 179ms.
- E0001 ACCEPTED: distinct radix HT partitioned on hash(G): -13.4%. Current best 1.155x, q16 ~171ms.
- Facts from earlier db_evolve runs (global auto-memory, same engine):
  - Skip unpartitioned staging for heap (VARCHAR) layouts: ~-5%, noisy. In backlog.
  - Early HT grow (-3%) and early SkipLookups (<=3%) are noise. Don't repeat.
  - Join output reaches the agg as ~300-row chunks. Main-HT re-sink costs ~150ns/row.
  - Gotcha: wrapping q16 in count(*) lets the optimizer drop DISTINCT. Use max(cnt) instead.
- Code locations: RadixPartitionedHashTable::Sink radix_partitioned_hashtable.cpp:548; AddChunk aggregate_hashtable.cpp:564; FindOrCreateGroupsInternal :641.

## Round g1r2 (2026-11-24): profile after E0001 (operator CPU)
- HASH_GROUP_BY 0.57s (distinct HT only: CanSkipRegularSink already skips the main sink when all aggs are DISTINCT, physical_hash_aggregate.cpp:382).
- Distinct HT key layout: p_brand compressed to uhugeint, p_type is raw VARCHAR (>16B so CM can't compress it, giving a heap layout), p_size utinyint, plus suppkey.
- partsupp scan 0.23-0.28s (8M rows, min/max + hashed BF; emits 1.236M, join keeps 1.185M). No exact bitmap BF in this tree (bloom_filter.hpp has only BloomFilter).
- Part side: `p_size IN (8 consts)` becomes an OptionalFilter(InFilter), zonemap only, in TryPushdownInFilter filter_combiner.cpp:580. InClauseRewriter (>=6 consts, in_clause_rewriter.cpp:60) then makes a MARK join + FILTER: scan emits 1.86M rows, mark 0.03s, filter 0.02s, giving 296k.
- PushdownGet (pushdown_get.cpp:105-128) tries generic ExpressionFilter pushdown only for NO_PUSHDOWN results and skips COMPARE_IN when CanThrow.
- The scan never evaluates IN_FILTER at row level (column_segment.cpp filter switch has no IN case). EXPRESSION_FILTER is supported.
- Dispatched: push the constant IN list as a scan ExpressionFilter (pushdown_get.cpp).
- `dbe-tool profile q16.m0` gives the EXPLAIN ANALYZE tree. Pipe it through tail only (no cd/head).

## Backlog / next ideas
- Exact bitmap BF for the dense-int partsupp probe (filed). Earlier runs: q09/q21 -9..-15%.
- Unpartitioned-staging gate for VARCHAR layouts (backlog, ~-5%).
- p_type VARCHAR in the distinct HT key: a dictionary/ID-based group key or longer-string CM compression could shrink the layout (idea, unverified).
- Compact ~300-row join output chunks before the agg sink (idea).

issues.title: Push constant IN-list as scan ExpressionFilter instead of MARK join
issues.hypothesis: In q16 the part scan has `p_size IN (8 constants)`. FilterCombiner::TryPushdownInFilter (filter_combiner.cpp:515-586) pushes a non-dense integral IN list only as an OptionalFilter(InFilter), which is zonemap-only, and returns PUSHED_DOWN_PARTIALLY. The full IN expression stays above the scan. InClauseRewriter (in_clause_rewriter.cpp:60, >=6 constants) then turns it into a MARK join against a COLUMN_DATA_SCAN plus FILTER. The profile shows the result: the part scan emits 1,856,009 rows (0.09s), the MARK join takes 0.03s, and FILTER IN(...) takes 0.02s to get down to 296,389 rows. That is all on the hash-join build pipeline, which has to finish before the 8M-row partsupp probe can start. PushdownGet (pushdown_get.cpp:105-128) only tries TryPushdownGenericExpression for NO_PUSHDOWN results, and it explicitly skips COMPARE_IN when CanThrow, so the partially pushed IN never becomes a real scan filter. Evaluating the IN as a scan ExpressionFilter applies the filter inside the scan's selection chain. That removes the 1.86M-row MARK join, the FILTER and the projection traffic, and gives the scan a real filter for cardinality estimation.
issues.plan: In src/optimizer/pushdown/pushdown_get.cpp PushdownGet, in the loop at lines 105-128: also handle filters whose result is PUSHED_DOWN_PARTIALLY when the expression is COMPARE_IN, children[0] is a BOUND_COLUMN_REF, every other child is a non-NULL BoundConstantExpression (the same conditions TryPushdownInFilter checks), !expr.IsVolatile() and !expr.CanThrow(). For those, call combiner.TryPushdownGenericExpression(get, expr). If it returns PUSHED_DOWN_FULLY, erase the filter from `filters` and `pushdown_results`, as is already done for NO_PUSHDOWN. The existing OptionalFilter(InFilter) stays for zonemap pruning, and PushFilter ANDs the two on the same column. Keep the generic pushdown gated on get.function.pushdown_expression; TryPushdownGenericExpression already checks it. Verify with EXPLAIN that q16's part scan shows the IN filter, has no MARK join or FILTER above it, and emits about 296k rows. Correctness checks: IN with NULL constant (not pushed), NOT IN (unchanged), IN on VARCHAR, IN with 6, 8 and 100 values, and a parquet scan.
issues.expected_gain: q16 -4..-8%. It removes about 0.05s CPU of MARK join plus FILTER, shrinks the part-scan output 6x on the HJ build pipeline, and makes the build-side estimate more accurate.
issues.generality: Any query with `col IN (>=6 non-dense constants)` directly on a base-table column (TPC-H q16/q19/q22-style IN lists, dashboard filters). The scan evaluates the IN early and skips the MARK join. A very long IN list (thousands of values) is evaluated by ExpressionExecutor as N equality passes, which can be slower than a hash MARK join. Cap it, for example at <=64 constants.
issues.risk: Low-medium. The optimizer change is small. Changed cardinality estimates can shift join orders on hidden queries. The scan ExpressionFilter path is already used for other generic expressions, so execution correctness risk is low.

issues.title: Exact bitmap BF for dense-int join keys on partsupp-style probes
issues.hypothesis: The q16 partsupp scan takes 0.28s for 8M rows with a min/max and BF dynamic filter. It emits 1,236,280 rows, but the join keeps 1,185,556, so about 51k are BF false positives. The build keys are dense ints, with 296k of the 2M range selected. In earlier db_evolve runs an exact bitmap BF over [min,max] gave q09 -9..-14% and q21 -15% on lineitem scans. This tree has no exact bitmap: bloom_filter.hpp only has class BloomFilter.
issues.plan: Port the exact dense-int bitmap from earlier runs. When the build key is integral and max-min <= 128*count bits, build a bitmap instead of the hashed BF, and probe with (key-min) bit tests in the scan's BLOOM_FILTER evaluation. Files: src/include/duckdb/planner/filter/bloom_filter.hpp, its .cpp, and the join filter pushdown in physical_hash_join.cpp.
issues.expected_gain: q16 -3..-6%: no hashing on 8M probes and no FP rows.
issues.generality: Joins on dense integer keys (surrogate keys) with a selective build side.
issues.risk: Medium. It is a larger diff, and the bitmap size has to be capped.
